items.title: Jason Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2025
items.q: trumpet players who have influenced me and my generation like that I think of people like Ambrose Akinmusire, Jonathan Finlayson, Sean Jones, Philip Dizak, Adam O’Farrill

ctx.x: Oh Jeez I wish I knew. Well you know the trumpet is a very — I wouldn’t want to say unforgiving but it’s an instrument that takes a lot of work to really make it a very malleable instrument. It’s an instrument that, it takes a lot, you’ve got to do a lot of work on yourself. I mean you have to, it’s kind of like being, I don’t know, like an opera singer. You know you have to have proper breath control, embouchure support and you know it’s unlike most all other wind instruments. Maybe French horn is maybe just as…

there’s a little bit of who — but it’s all — it’s none of those people it’s just like a combination of all those people. And so you know I want to say that people that hire me might hear that in my playing, but you know that’s kind of not a question for me I guess. On the other side of it I really enjoy like playing in other people’s bands and helping them bring their music to life. You know I end up getting called to play in bands with people who write really complicated music that’s beautiful at the same time.…
